about_the_game:
Spinera is a slot machine-inspired roguelike deck builder, all about creating powerful combos and thriving your civilization through the eras. Lead your civilization toward upcoming eras! This game does not contain any real-world currency gambling or microtransactions. 

In order to beat your era score and survive through time, spin the slot machine, get resources, and combine spin results with the technologies you have discovered. Uncover new technologies, find out great persons, construct amazing wonders, and build your deck through turns. Uncover all hidden leaders and decks as you progress. You’re going to need every edge you can get in order to reach the next era for your people and to secure victory!

You can add, remove, enhance & seal the symbols in your deck, and build the ultimate deck to create incredible combos that no other leader can reach besides you!

Allocate your generated resources carefully. Are you gonna use your resources to discover new technologies? Or do you decide to get a new great person to assist you in hard times, train a soldier, or use your economic power to alter situations?

  • Discover technologies that affect the outcome of your symbols!

  • Discover great people to alter your gameplay immediately!

  • Train soldiers to defend against others or rush towards them!

  • Manipulate your game board with your economic power!

Expand your territory the way you like to rule! Build your own slot machine and experience the joy of luxury resources!

Survive against enemies or knock on their doors to get what you truly deserve! Be defensive or offensive, select how you want to rule the world under your leadership!

Construct game-changing wonders to alter the course of your destiny.

  • The ultimate slot machine roguelike experience.

  • Endless possibilities - Every leader, decision, technology, and event can dramatically alter the course of your run and civilization.

  • Collect your leaders, make high scores, and compete with other civilizations to rule them all!

A THRILLING LUCK-BASED STRATEGIC EXPERIENCE FOR ALL LEADERS WHO SEEK TO CHALLENGE THE MERCY OF TIME!

‘Every civilization needs a bit of luck to survive.’
